bagPolicy.summary: For all events, clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches and wallets or small purses up to 6.5 × 4.5 × 1.5 inches are permitted. Medical and diaper bags are exceptions; backpacks are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Use the event-specific patron parking map to identify open lots; the arena recommends allowing at least 45 minutes to park and enter. Prepaid parking is tied to a designated lot.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Use the rideshare area between University Drive and Belmont Street next to the Alumni and Friends Center.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The arena accepts cards, phone payment apps, and prepaid debit cards at concessions and provides no-fee reverse ATMs to convert cash.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: A sensory room is on the ground level at west-side Lobby 3, and sensory kits can be requested from Guest Services with an ID held as collateral. A private lactation room is between west-side Lobbies 3 and 4.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is prohibited, although a Guest Services supervisor may make an exception for medical or similar circumstances.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are delivered to your phone, so pull them up before you arrive for quicker entry. Buy only through the ExtraMile Arena Box Office, Ticketmaster, or authorized Fan Clubs.

gates.summary: Security may use magnetometers, visual inspection, and bag checks at entry; refusing a search can result in denied admission. The guide does not give a universal door-opening time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
